reviews.text:
Great live classes, but not if you have a job or sleep nights. I live in Pacific Standard Time (west coast of USA) and I have a day job. I love the live classes, because the feedback and support helps and motivates me. 

Here is this week’s schedule of classes for my time zone: Friday- 1:30am to 8:05 am. 
Saturday- 1:15 am to 2 am. 
Sunday- 2am to 1:25 pm. 
Monday- 2:15 am to 2:20 pm. 
Tuesday- 8 am to 11:30 pm. 
Wednesday- 12:15 am to 7:20 pm. 
Thursday- 3 am to 11:55 am. 
Friday- 12am to 10:35 am. 

For people who work 8am to 5pm Monday through Friday, (and who generally sleep at 2 in the morning), you can only take live classes on Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday. If I lived in Eastern Standard Time, it would be even worse. Live classes would be very late at night and crazy early in the morning. This is irritating because Yogaia bills itself as “take a yoga class anytime, anywhere”. Sure you can take recorded classes, but then you don’t get feedback, and you can get plenty of recorded classes for free on YouTube. I genuinely like the live classes, and the instructors are fabulous. This is the perfect solution to yoga if you live in Europe. I did send an email to Mikko (“please don’t hesitate to get in touch!”) about this issue, but never received a response. 

I bought a year subscription regardless. I will have to make due with the crazy hours.

In response from ERIKA, who clearly woke up on the wrong side of bed this morning, I was told they do not offer trials (even when their app literally did offer me one), and that I’m banned from using this service - just like that with no explanation given. When you can take a class anytime, it’s so easy to postpone, but when I have a time set with an expectation I’m better about attendance. When I turn my camera on I get great feedback but it’s a non issue to leave your camera off. I have done the recorded classes, most teachers are excellent, but live is what’s keeping me practicing.

Fun, Challenging and Educational. I’ve been using the Yogaia app for approaching a month now and have happily accessed their vast library of recorded classes every day. All of the classes are informative, fun and also challenging. I will definitely be purchasing a year’s subscription as I can’t imagine being without this app now - I’ve learnt a huge amount since starting Yogaia and look forwards every day to following a big variety of different instructors in an even bigger variety of classes that suit every need. Even if, like me, you aren’t brave enough yet to try a live class, the recorded classes are a great place to start building your confidence and developing your skills. Highly recommended!
Yogaia. Awesome !!! Awesome teachers and classes!! Great value!!!

Great way to access great yoga classes. Yogia’s a great find! You can access any level of any kind of yoga or meditation class at anytime. There are also HIT classes and Pilates too. The live classes take place throughout daytime and nighttime and the recordings library mean you can access as many sessions as you wish whatever the time of day you choose. All of the teachers give really clear explanations of how to move into each pose and what you can expect to feel once in pose. I used to go to yoga classes where we practiced only Hatha yoga, now I practise a wide range of yoga from vinyasa through to yin - something I could never have done via my old classes! There are classes for every level from beginner to super advanced! Also specific classes to target specific problems - for lower back, neck& shoulders, core, yoga for pregnancy - something for everyone!
Yogia’s a really, good find and when you compare it to the cost of classes, a really, really cost effective way of doing yoga. Brilliant classes, brilliant teachers - something for everyone!

The best thing. It's the best thing I did. Joining yogaia. I absolutely love it and am totally hooked.i recommend it to everybody young and old.i have improved a lot and use the live classes when I can and the rest of the time I use the recordings. Brilliant

Back on the mat!. Yogaia’s live classes make me feel like I am taking a real studio class in my own living room. It is so much easier to stay focused when somebody is on the other side of the camera helping you out. I am doing more yoga now and feeling the difference!

I saw a review further below by someone who seemed to want this all for free. Is that a joke? Would that person be happy to work for free? Seriously, if you want free yoga sessions, go to YouTube. Not at all understanding. Unfortunately I have had to write this review, due to my issue not being rectified.

They then, after I explained that the process had meant me having to purchase the next month after the trial, refused to take any action apart from to keep repeating steps to cancel my(already cancelled) membership. 

I have now have paid for something I don't need and a company refusing to see my problem.
More yoga in less time. Without Yogaia I wouldn’t be able attend half the classes I do. I love the variety of class types and teachers. Changed my life for sure.

I love the connection with the teachers. I love that when I do classes on Yogaia, if I want the teacher to see me, I put on my camera and they can. I can be lazy at home so having a real person notice when I’m not doing it right and have a joke with me like they would in a studio is amazing. It really is the closest thing to a studio you can get from home and there are so so many classes!! I also live the recordings when I can’t choose what I want to do so I can try a few and do what I want to. Love this app!!

reviews.text: Love it!. Top class instructors and a huge variety of classes!
A Brilliant Yoga Site.... A great site with lots of flexibility offering live classes or recorded classes at beginner to advanced levels. Very good instructors too... would recommend...
Great for beginners. This yoga app is brilliant.

This is Life-Changing Stuff!. I've had this app just 4 days, and so far have "attended" a total of 11 yoga classes, 2 of which were live. As something of a recluse, discovering this app has opened up a world of possibility for me, and I'm now binge-yogaing! 

Having only dabbled very briefly in Hatha Yoga over a decade ago, I was pleased to find plenty of nice, gentle, easy classes to get me started without too much pressure! There seem to be a good range of intermediate and advanced classes on offer too. The instructors I've seen have all been really good, and each brings their own style and experience to the class, so you get to know whose classes suit you best. I have yet to feel brave enough turn my camera on so the instructor can see me, but I may be tempted to do so in future as I've seen the additional level of support they have provided to other users. 

The app works relatively smoothly, and is easy to navigate, with my only complaint being that the calendar function seems a little buggy - if I add more than a week's worth of classes (I tried to schedule daily classes for a month - see how enthusiastic it has got me?!) it doesn't seem to work correctly. Though that could be as much down to my overly-full and already buggy iCal app, to be fair. It would also be nice if the recorded classes that I have scheduled for myself could be included as calendar entries too.

Thank you to the Yogaia team for finding a way to bring the mountain to Muhammad 💜

Yogaia. This is the best interactive training I have found. The live sessions are amazing and being able to choose from a great selection of recordings when I cannot meet the timings is an added bonus. Being able to tailor the selections to my needs makes it perfect. I highly recommend this app

reviews.text: Brilliant app- even for beginners 😄. I think this app is genius. I don't have to waste my time driving to a class finding a parking space, waiting for it start and then doing it all in reverse. There is no stress with these classes, just switch on and there it is. The instructors are very friendly and help correct your positions. The only downside for me as I work full time, is to have more classes at earlier times such as 06:30 GMT so I can do a class before I travel to work. So far I've only done the 'live' classes but there does seem to be a lot of recorded classes to choose from. I am really pleased that I've joined this and hope that my flexibility will improve by doing a couple of 'live' classes a week supplemented by a few recordings. I'm looking forward to do my classes even when I'm away from home 😄😄😄

Amazing app. As a healthcare professional with a very busy schedule and long hours, it's hard for me to go from work to my local yoga studio and make it to the classes. It can seem like a lot of money but it's cheaper than booking onto local classes and the deals they do save you a lot of money. The quality of the classes is very high too so it's definitely worth it. When my subscription runs out I will definitely renew it.

reviews.text:
Excellent Yoga App - Guided Yoga Classes From Home!. I love the fact that I can now take guided yoga classes from the comfort of my bedroom or lounge without having to leave the home! 

The Yogaia app has a wide range of classes available anytime, anywhere. It makes doing yoga highly accessible which is something many people are looking for.

There are numerous yoga teachers offering various styles of yoga and there are both live classes and recorded versions. I really like the idea of attending live classes - without having to go to a yoga studio. 

The yoga teachers also have the ability to help those in the online class and attendees can turn on their webcam to be guided into the correct position. This is useful, especially for anyone looking to get the most out of each asana and to avoid the risk of injuries. 

I love this app and will highly recommend it to all of my friends. Well done on creating such a great app!

reviews.text: Brilliant. Great range of classes!

It does buffer and I'm not sure if that's down to my broadband, other than than no issues. 

I had to contact them regarding an injury and they emailed straight back and were super helpful.

I can do it at home while my kids watch CBeebies for half an hour! So pleased and so thankful to the makers of this app! Our gym closed down recently as the owner wanted to sell the land, this left an enormous hole in our town for decent quality yoga and pilates instruction. Yoga-tastic!. I subscribed to the free 7 day trial and used this app every day, sometimes twice a day. I was considering joining a local class but fitting them around my lifestyle was proving difficult. However, this app is amazing, it's suitable for all levels, it clearly says which level each class is for, how long the class is and which type of yoga. I am very impressed by this app. My only negative so far is that some of the videos don't appear as clear as they should, that said, they are perfectly adequate.

So the single star's for the pricing model, content may be fine for you, I didn't look!

Yoga & Pilates on demand, wherever you are!. Love the concept of this app, it's perfect for those who need yoga and Pilates in their life more than what their gym or pocket can provide. 

The instructors are great - clear and concise. Classes are varied and there is something for everyone - whatever you ability and/or timescales. 

The only slide gripe is the camera quality isn't wonderful, however more than sufficient. 

Overall, I'm recommending this app to many of my buddies.

This is how exercise should be!. I love that finally people are making exercise more accessible. I've been a gym goer for years, spending hundreds every month on crowded and frantic gyms in the city. Now I feel empowered and free to workout at home and it's brilliant. Truly brilliant.

Amazing! Life changing!. In started this a few months ago and haven't looked back. It's so easy and convenient to use. It feels different to any other yoga app I've used before- the whole company is very professional! Thanks
Finding inner peace. For a long time I have wanted to practice yoga, but due to life commitments getting to a class has been very difficult. Yoogaia is helping me to learn from experts in my own time
I love this app!. I am one thankful stay-at-home mum! Moved out of London and really struggled to find well taught and challenging yoga classes. Thank goodness for Yoogaia. X

Amazing classes with great teachers!. I love yoga and I love taking classes several times a week, but I work long hours and if I'm supposed to cook healthily each night and then grab my gym bag, get over to the class, do the class, take a shower and come home... I mean, who the heck has time for that?!
Enter Yoogaia, where you can just roll out your mat at home and start your class. No muss, no fuss!
I personally find I get the best results from attending the live classes and enabling my camera. You don't have to do that - the recorded classes are great for when a meeting runs late & you can always switch off your camera - as often the teacher will tell me how I can get into the pose a bit better, a bit deeper.... I also have a lower back injury, which I inform the teachers of at the beginning of the class - so when there's a tricky pose coming up, I'll be given an alternative. I mean... It just makes for an interactive class right out of my own home!
The only bit I do sometimes struggle with is the connection. Sometimes the video feed will cut out and the instructions won't come through properly, so I'll be "flying blind" basically. It doesn't happen often, but when it does, it's such a shame! I really didn't want to take off a star, but for that reason I have to.
All in all I would definitely recommend though!!!

Easy to use at home and instructors will respond to your comments. This app is wonderful having live and recorded sessions. I enjoy having chance to review the classes, the instructors and tools required. Though courses are not specific to my present position, I get a bit of private practice.

super!. I am really enjoying this app, what a great idea to make classes available to you any time, anywhere. After a busy day and long commute, it is wonderful to be able to do yoga at home in the warmth and comfort of your own surrounds! The teachers are clear in their explanations and very encouraging (although I use the recordings rather than live classes).

Yoogia. I can't even begin to describe how life changing this app has been for me. The ability to pick and choose the classes that I want, when I want and to revisit favourites anytime is brilliant. Best site and app that I've come across in a long time to help me fit health and happiness to my own timetable
Excellent Yoga App. I am really enjoying using this app, the teachers are very helpful and supportive especially if you use the camera on the live classes . So far I have been very impressed .

reviews.text: Brilliant!. I love having the choice of so many classes & have found the sound and picture quality no problem at all. The instructors are great and explain things well-great app & great service.

Room for improvements. I'm a subscriber to Yogaglo so very excited to discover a new service. The live classes is a nice idea and the camera feature adds more interactivity. Though I personally would never use the camera, I look a mess when I practice at home! :) 

I tried out a couple of recorded classes. The teachers seem to be experienced and professional. But I was struck by how poor the picture quality is. It was probably due to the fact that they were live streams so the pictures were quite fuzzy. 

The app itself is hit and miss. The filtering isn't great, and I'm not sure why it doesn't bring up all filter results. I had to go to the website to find classes that are more than a day old. I'm on trial and I'm not convinced that I'll subscribe. I kind of wish it was more polished and provide a better experience. I'll try out a few more classes and see.

Very good for time-challenged people. This app is very useful for keeping fit at times that suit you. You can choose to join live classes or record them for a more convenient time. There's a good variety of classes and I really like some of the instructors' ways of teaching. I also like the fact that you can choose to have your camera on in the live classes so the instructor can correct your pose if necessary.

Doesn't work properly, classes are inaccurate & it's too expensive. I'm using iPhone 5C and it crashes during video play. Instructions are not accurate and paying £14.99 for something which freely available to the world is nonsense.

Best yoga app by far 👌🏽. Sceptical on yoga apps but this one is by far the best , i did my first one with the app this morning, live class with Richard Tumu i think , clear, informative and such a good teacher and flow , i will be doing his classes again. Get the app i mean who doesn't want to be able to do yoga at home looking a mess instead of getting on the tube for an hour just to get there lol x

Great app. Fantastic

Absolutely Brilliant App. For someone who travels constantly and is also concerned with staying aligned and healthy this app is absolutely brilliant! Good choice of classes, length of workouts, teachers and most importantly the chance to take classes live which makes it that much easier to participate as you do nor feel it is all on your shoulders to get going! Perhaps would enjoy having more live options, but with the recorded versions no more excuse of not having time to exercise - whenever and wherever there is wifi. Also super easy to use even for the toughest tech resistors! Thank you!
Brilliant & convenient. Excellent instruction. Lots of varied workouts. Easy to follow. Something for everyone. Highly recommended.

Dan. Fantastic app, I use it twice a week to complement other workouts and it's brilliant, simple to use and I mirror onto the big TV screen. You can pick and choose routines to fit your style and needs. Live session times are a little limited but that is my only fault. Awesome x
Fantastic!. Really easy to use and brilliant classes! Highly recommended!

Great app & loving Yoogaia. The app is really clear and super easy to use. I have been with Yoogaia for nearly a year now. I am using the service anything between 2-5 times a week. There is no way I would have time to go the the gym that many times a week. Yoogaia fits in YOUR lifestyle rather that you needing to fit your lifestyle around exercise. 
I love the different "feel" of classes depending where they come from. Hong Kong classes have a bit of an Eastern feel to them, often some postures too that aren't often used in the west. I am lucky I can also do the Finnish classes (I am a Finn living in UK) so always have so much variety to choose from! 
Just give Yoogaia a try!!!!! You won't regret it.
Loving this!. This is a great app! I'm currently enjoying a 7 day free trial and am considering paying the quite high subscription fee as it really is that good!

Yoogaia. Wow! What an amazing range of classes to chose from, this is just what I need to get me back into fitness.. And all from home! I have tried the abs and easy yoga class and the Barre Cardio - fabulous! Amazing that the teacher can actually see me and tell me how to correct my position - I'm a convert! Great and easy to use, especially when I am time poor (most of the time).
A motivating workout. A great app! Can easily take classes in the early morning and the live experience means that the instructors don't let me slack off!

reviews.text: A yoga family. I have been with Yogaia for many years. I always love to come back and see my yoga family.
Needs Chromecast support!. My Apple TV is in my bedroom, but I do yoga in my living room. We have a Chromecast there, and this is a must-have for me. Please consider adding soon 🧘

Love it!. Love Yogaia! You can participate in live classes where they help you directly (if you turn your camera on), or do recorded classes any time you want. There is a range of types of classes from restorative/yin to athletic, and even meditation classes. I love that there is different lengths of classes from 5mins to 45mins and I can schedule a few movement breaks in during the work-from-home day. The teachers are all great, and really care about, and check in with, their live students to make sure there is proper positioning and that poses are being done right. They will also show modifications for all levels of students. Yogaia is fantastic! Check it out and sign up!

Love this App. Love this app - I use it every morning before work to take a pre-recorded class, and then I fit in a live class where I can at any point through the day. Instructors are wonderful, and the app just makes it so easy to make yoga a part of your life!

❤️❤️❤️. I love Yogaia! I am soooooo thankful that they have introduced some new classes from the LA studio! These are more convenient for my time zone and allow me to finally access live evening classes again! The instructors are amazing and the fact that I can practice/workout with a live instructor, in the comfort of my own home is priceless! No need to brave the Northern Ontario cold to go to class! I’ve even folded laundry and done chores during the break between classes! Please consider making a few evening classes a bit earlier for our time zone (Eastern time zone). I still attend some live classes during the week but most begin at 9&10pm or later. Keep up the good work Yogaia! Thank you!

reviews.text: Great app!. Great app! Awesome teachers!

Yoga-to-go...anywhere, anytime. This app works really well for me -- three most important: (1) the teachers are really, REALLY, good, and explain poses and modifications extremely well. (2) It doesn't matter whether you have a few minutes, or an hour or more -- there's a USEFUL class to fit your timeframe, and your schedule. I am developing a real fondness for Yin...and one of these days, I'm going to check out Forest Yoga, too...keep up the good work, Yogaia!

So far so good. I was very pleased with the first couple of classes I tried.
Great app!. Love it!

.... Just.... WOW!!!😀. Thank you so much... from the bottom of my ❤️. 
I discovered your app while browsing for a new yoga app. 
Myself and my husband have been practicing using the Yoga Studio app for approximately 8 months. I have attended classes in the past but have found it to be a too much of a hassle, no parking, classes are too crowded, leave sweaty and into the cold( Canadian winter) etc etc. I enjoy practicing in my home as those issues disappear. With the other app, I have not had any criticism or corrections which is not so great. 
I downloaded the Yoogaia app after reading rave reviews. 
I am 4 days into my free trial and I am SOLD!
The app is extremely helpful as you can book into LIVE classes :) Can also download archived classes too. I am in love with Yoogia. It is an awesome program done very well and I recommend this to everyone, flexible or not!! My husband and I both use this program and tho the cost may seem a bit high, it's worth it and way less than the cost for two people at a studio

Unsubscribed, took my money anyway. Got a free month of this app through Boost juice scratchie. Logged in and unsubscribed as didn’t get a chance to use it due to injury. The app has now charged a subscription fee and I can’t log in to check/change anything. It now doesn’t recognise either my login name or password (presumably because I cancelled my account!!). Will now have to dispute the transaction on my credit card as can’t find any other way to get in. Disappointing.

Boutique studio feels, very valuable teachings. I have been using Yogaia since 2016, and I am now a lifetime member, because I can’t do without it anymore 😄From short yoga sessions as telework breaks, to yoga nidra when I can’t fall asleep, barre and kettle bells to be more active or even self care massages, it’s a nice blend for a more mindful life. My yoga and meditation practices really progressed thanks to the high level quality of the all the teachers. Yogaia feels to me like a little boutique studio where your are familiar to the teachers and they greet you by your name when you enter 🙏😊 Thank you for the good work!

Good variety. Great videos and good varsity of type, length, skill level. I use the already recorded classes as the live classes don’t match my Timezone. My only recommendation would be having an ability to cast the recorded videos from my phone to my tv.
Best Yoga app I’ve used yet. Great teachers, great classes, lots of variety and lots of different timed classes from 5 minutes to 75 minutes...just signed up for another year 🕉

Super convenient and wide range of classes. I've been using the app for over 18 months now with a year long subscription to complement my face to face classes when travelling or busy, especially the meditation classes. Some really fantastic teachers and very accessible. Highly recommend.

Great instructors and great classes. The classes are great and so are their teachers.. with yogaia and manduka i have lost my pregnancy weight. I do have a long way to go but in saying that the teachers at yogaia and manduka have helped me achieve that.
Rip off junk. Only free is one 10 minute video everything else is $69 for three months - rip off junk
